parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Compound **F** contains 31.4% oxygen by mass and its mass spectrum has a molecular ion peak at $m/e = 102$.

Use all of this information to show that the molecular formula of compound **F** is $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_2$. Show all your working.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: There are **four** possible structural isomers of $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_2$ that are carboxylic acids.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the systematic name of isomer 1.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
**F** is one of the four structural isomers in **(b)(i)**. A carbon-13 NMR spectrum of **F** is shown.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}
parts.text:
Use the spectrum to identify isomer **F**. Draw its structure in the box below.

{{figure:pdf_visual_03.png}}
